tasks.spec:
Your current working directory IS a git worktree of the loop-factory repo. Edit files here directly. Do NOT git commit/branch/push/stash. No MCP, no network, no model calls, no skills. Factory code is department-agnostic: NO department names, thresholds, or per-department branches anywhere in your code — that is this repo's core rule.

OWNED FILES (only these; both new):
  factory/boardfeed.py
  tests/test_boardfeed.py

TASK: Build the estate board-feed aggregator per the LOCKED contract in wayfinder/drafts/10-rollup-proposal.md (read it in full, including the v1.1 objectives/funnel and v1.2 telemetry addenda). The aggregator PULLS from department state read-only and emits estate/state/board-feed.ndjson.

Behavior:
1. CLI: python3 -m factory.boardfeed --repo-root <path> [--out <path>] [--department <name>]. Default out: <repo-root>/estate/state/board-feed.ndjson. --department restricts to one department (for per-loop boards).
2. Discover departments by listing <repo-root>/departments/*/ that contain a state/ dir. For each, read READ-ONLY: state/STATE.json, state/heartbeats.jsonl (last line), state/runs-v2.jsonl (may be absent — tolerate), state/approval_queue.jsonl (may be absent), charter.yaml via factory/charter_loader.py load for objective setpoints IF the charter carries a setpoints/objectives mapping (tolerate absence — emit nothing rather than inventing).
3. Emit NDJSON lines, one JSON object each: {id, kind, ts, department, data} with string id '<kind>:<department>:<subject>:<ts-bucket>' (ts-bucket = UTC hour for status/metrics, full ts for events). Kinds per contract: dept_status (autonomy_state, epoch, last_cycle_at, ok, open_findings count, escalations), active_run (from the LAST 24h of runs-v2.jsonl: run_id, node, status, attempt, engine, model, ts), andon (from STATE open_findings with severity, plus ANY runs-v2 record with status 'blocked' and auth_class 'blocked' → an AUTH andon; plus any record carrying metered_violation → a POLICY andon), approval (open approval_queue rows: status, queued_at, age_s), metrics (daily rollup per department: runs, ok/error/blocked counts, tokens_in/tokens_out summed from usage, model_calls; per-lane telemetry rows {lane: engine, model, auth_class, calls, tokens_in, tokens_out}; objective rows from charter setpoints when present {objective_id, label, setpoint, minimum, target, observed:'unknown' unless derivable}).
4. HONESTY RULES (contract): unmeasured emits the string 'unknown', never 0; a metered/violation record becomes an andon line, never a stat; missing files are tolerated silently but a corrupt/unparseable line is COUNTED in a final feed line {kind:'feed_health', data:{malformed: n}} — never silently dropped.
5. Deterministic: same inputs → byte-identical output (sort lines by (department, kind, id); no wall-clock in ids except from record data; take 'now' from an optional --now ISO argument for tests, defaulting to real now).
6. Atomic write: temp + fsync + os.replace. Use the logging module; stdout prints only a one-line JSON receipt {departments, lines, malformed}.

tests/test_boardfeed.py — at least 9 tests with tmp_path fixture departments (INVENT a fake department name like 'demodept' — proving department-agnosticism): dept_status line from STATE fixture; active_run lines from runs-v2 fixture rows (valid per factory/runrecord.py — import and build real records for fixtures); auth-blocked record → andon line; metered_violation record → POLICY andon line and NOT counted in token stats; approval ages computed from --now; per-lane telemetry aggregation across two engines; objective rows emitted from a charter fixture with setpoints and omitted without; malformed jsonl line counted in feed_health; determinism (two runs, byte-identical); --department filter restricts output.

VERIFY: 'python3 loopfactory.py check' full suite green. You fail for touching files outside the owned list, fewer than 9 new 'def test_' functions, any department name in factory code, or the verify command failing.
tasks.verified: a department-agnostic aggregator emits the locked board-feed contract from real department state, honestly (unknown never 0, violations become andons), deterministically, atomically

Factory code is department-agnostic: NO department names or per-department branches in code — loop-specific content arrives as feed DATA.

OWNED FILES (only these; both new):
  factory/board.py
  tests/test_board.py

TASK: Build the board RENDERER per the locked Board Template v1 spec at wayfinder/drafts/17-board-template-spec.md (read it in full) with the approved visual reference at wayfinder/prototypes/11-andon-board.html (read it — REUSE its CSS custom properties, class vocabulary, and zone structure; that page is the design contract: light editorial, oxblood red reserved for needs-a-human, HTML-text graphs, capped-width SVG only for trend lines).

Behavior:
1. CLI: python3 -m factory.board --feed <board-feed.ndjson> --out <page.html> [--department <name>] [--title <str>]. No network, fully self-contained output HTML (inline CSS, no external assets).
2. Zone grammar, fixed order (estate mode): Header (from dept_status lines: department count, healthy/degraded, epoch, generated-at, honesty label 'LIVE — rendered from board-feed.ndjson') → Zone 1 Metrics (objective rows rendered as: bullet graph when minimum+target present [HTML bullet, CSS widths]; percent + label otherwise; 'unknown' observed renders the literal word unknown in muted style; plus daily metric stats) → Zone 2 Main actions (andon lines as red blocks — fault, department, age, detail; approval lines as an inbox with ages; if no andons: a quiet 'no andons — nothing needs you' line) → Zone 3 Activity (per-department outcome bars from daily metrics ok/blocked/error using CSS-width HTML bars; per-lane telemetry rows with OAuth/API route badges — an 'api'/metered lane row must render as an andon-styled alert, not a stat row) → Zone 4 Loop-specific (funnel_stage rows grouped by funnel_id rendered as HTML label+bar rows sorted by 'order'; any metrics group it has no renderer for → a generic labeled key:value list under the department's name — NEVER silently dropped).
3. --department mode renders the same grammar for one department only.
4. Missing kinds are tolerated: an empty feed renders a page saying 'no departments reporting' rather than crashing. Malformed feed lines are skipped but counted and shown in the footer ('N malformed feed lines').
5. Deterministic output for identical feed input.

tests/test_board.py — at least 9 tests, building fixture feed lines in-code (shape: {id, kind, ts, department, data}): full-fixture render contains all four zone headings and the honesty label; objective with min+target renders a bullet with both tick labels; observed 'unknown' renders the word unknown and never '0'; an andon line renders the red block content and the no-andon message disappears; a metered/api telemetry lane renders as an alert not a stat; funnel rows render in 'order' order with counts; unknown metrics group falls back to the labeled list (assert its values present); empty feed renders the no-departments message; malformed line count appears in footer; determinism (two renders byte-identical); --department filter excludes other departments' content. Parse-check the HTML with html.parser in at least one test.

VERIFY: 'python3 loopfactory.py check' full suite green. You fail for touching files outside the owned list, fewer than 9 new 'def test_' functions, external assets in the output, or the verify command failing.
